headline: Know what’s missing. Before you file.
copy: A provenance-first evidence audit for cargo damage and shortage claims. Explore one synthetic shipment with an unresolved POD signature, ambiguous photo date and conflicting draft value.
visual: Crisp white architectural grid; central glass dossier connected to emerald cargo-owner cube, modular 3PL blocks and silver insurer frame; persistent CONCEPT PREVIEW.
motion: On load: wordmark and navigation immediately visible; text rises 24px in 2–3 lines over 650ms; cargo resolves from a shallow mask. First scroll separates the central evidence panes and follows a source link into the dossier. No forced intro.
cta: Inspect sample claim → /demo/cases/FC-208; Request a pilot → /pilot

headline: The loss is visible. The evidence is scattered.
copy: BOL in one inbox. Photos at the warehouse. Delivery evidence unresolved. A draft amount that does not match the invoice.
visual: Cool silver-gray schematic route with four source islands; fictional origin/handoff/delivery, no real tracking.
motion: Vertical entry: each island enters from its actual handoff direction, then connector draws; missing source remains a gap.

headline: Follow one shipment into review.
copy: Open the BOL, inspect the delivery record, reconcile the draft value and assign the evidence chase.
visual: One desktop horizontal evidence strip with fixed case label; four labeled stops.
motion: Pinned only on wide/tall screens. Vertical scroll advances four stops; visible progress and Skip chapter. Each stop holds readable source+finding.
cta: Open each document → dossier source pane

headline: Keep the source. Show the uncertainty.
copy: Original attachments, origin metadata and reviewer corrections stay distinct. Uncertain OCR becomes a task, not an invented delivery notation.
visual: Deep graphite evidence vault; left document crop, center extracted field, right correction history.
motion: Vertical layered reveal: source rises, field connects from right, uncertainty underline appears; scroll reverses visual layers without altering data.

headline: Five offers. One clear first test.
copy: Start with Freight Desk. Evaluate rule tracking, reconciliation, reviewed packets and prevention reporting as separate offers.
visual: Crisp white editorial product index; five bespoke mini-scenes and direct page links.
motion: All names visible without horizontal interaction. One-time alternating 16–24px reveals; hover/focus highlights the owning workflow.

headline: Different roles. Explicit authority.
copy: Cargo owner, 3PL agent and insurer have different responsibilities. Contracting or insurance counsel validates standing and permitted handling.
visual: White and silver role topology; central analyst dossier, three distinct party geometries and separate counsel layer.
motion: Nodes enter by role; solid/dashed connectors distinguish recorded/awaiting authority. Keyboard role selector gives same explanation.

headline: A review queue with a next action.
copy: A. Chen owns FC-208’s evidence chase. The signed POD remains unresolved. The filing deadline remains Verify.
visual: Full-width readable workbench on paper; no floating illegible dashboard collage.
motion: Vertical stepper focuses source → discrepancy → assigned task → history. Actual clicks drive corrections; scroll only explains them.

headline: A deadline needs a source.
copy: Carrier, mode, contract, jurisdiction and rule owner belong beside every verified date. When applicability is unknown, the date stays unknown.
visual: Archive-style rule card, version spine and timeline with an intentional blank slot.
motion: A source slot slides open; no date “fills itself.” Reveal verification owner and missing contract label.

headline: Measure the audit against the workflow you already use.
copy: FreightClaims, carrier portals, spreadsheets, TMS workflows and recovery firms already serve this market. Test whether the audit adds useful evidence or saves preparation work.
visual: Neutral comparison matrix beside a sample audit comparison sheet; no winner trophy.
motion: Rows reveal once; selected baseline emphasizes evaluation fields.

headline: Test a 20-case bundle.
copy: Proposed test price: $400 for a retrospective 20-case audit; a subsequent $8 per audited intake case is a separate hypothesis. Scope and authority come first.
visual: Cool white and silver tray containing 20 case markers; calm commercial panel.
motion: Case tray settles once, numbers appear at final value; never count up from zero.

headline: Evidence before expansion.
copy: Target 10 claims-manager interviews, two permissioned retrospective sets and one paid 20-case audit within 45 days. Track preparation time, corrections, deficiency returns and outcomes only where knowable.
visual: Research scorecard with blank measured columns; synthetic report in a separate inset.
motion: Vertical milestones reveal with labels “target,” not achieved. Chart includes unknown outcome cohort.

headline: Clear answers before a pilot.
copy: Is this operating software? Who files? Which deadlines apply? Can I upload real documents? Is pricing final? What if my TMS already solves this?
visual: Paper FAQ with a small context-specific evidence glyph per topic.
motion: Accessible accordion; 180–240ms height/opacity transition or instant reduced motion.

headline: Bring a workflow. Start with a scoped audit.
copy: Tell us who owns claims, your case-volume range, carrier/mode and current software. Do not send claimant documents through this public concept.
visual: Quiet closed dossier with one open review tab; contrast returns to graphite.
motion: Text enters from below; CTA is immediately available. Footer remains ordinary readable layout.
